summary: GG 2.0.3-stable no longer white-screens and starts normally, but emulator testing found an external system-browser blank page and shop purchases only work once. A split 2.0.7-stable candidate was built to address both without restoring the previous multi-window WebView regression.

sourcePersistence.reason: The GitHub Actions token was not allowed to push a commit that also modified .github/workflows/v2-build-apks.yml. The verified APK artifact exists, and the deterministic patch script remains on the hotfix branch.

externalBlankBrowser.cause: The restored client forwarded every non-http/https URI to Android ACTION_VIEW. Emulator WebView navigation can expose intent:, about:blank, javascript:, data: or blob: URIs differently from the Android 11 physical device, causing a system browser blank page.
candidateFix: Handle both modern WebResourceRequest and deprecated String navigation callbacks
Keep normal http/https navigation inside the GG WebView
Keep about:, javascript:, data: and blob: internal
Block intent: and unknown external schemes
Only allow actual system schemes such as tel:, mailto:, sms: and smsto:

repeatPurchase.cause: The runtime still contains script 1.1.4 one-shot callback restoration, but restoring the stable Android client removed page-finish reinjection and delayed retries. After a page transition or shop re-entry the control script can therefore be absent or incompletely initialized.
candidateFix: Reinject the control script after target-page completion
Retry injection after 250 ms, 1200 ms and 3000 ms
Use a loading guard to prevent duplicate concurrent injection

acceptanceRequired: Launch GG and confirm startup remains fast and no white screen returns
Confirm the emulator no longer opens a system-browser blank page
Buy two different shop items consecutively without leaving the shop
Return to the story, reopen the shop and complete a third purchase

nextDecision.allPass: Persist only the verified client source changes to the hotfix branch without changing a workflow file in the same automated push, review the exact diff, merge or promote, build a formal release, then remove temporary dispatch files.
nextDecision.externalBrowserStillFails: Do not broaden navigation handling. Add targeted WebView navigation and Android intent logging, then provide a one-click capture script only if repository and build resources cannot reveal the URI.
nextDecision.repeatPurchaseStillFails: Instrument the one-shot callback lifecycle, target-page injection state and shop navigation without changing license, runtime encryption or network endpoints.
nextDecision.whiteScreenReturns: Stop promotion, reinstall 2.0.3-stable code16, and isolate the reinjection timing change from the navigation fix.

protectedAreas: Do not rotate or change TOKEN_SIGNING_SECRET, RUNTIME_MASTER_KEY or LICENSE_ADMIN_PASSWORD for this client UI task
Do not redeploy or republish the encrypted runtime unless a separate runtime integrity error is observed
Do not restore setSupportMultipleWindows(true), onCreateWindow or a temporary popup WebView
Do not state that 2.0.7-stable is formally released before emulator acceptance
